prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical natural DSLR coastal fashion portrait of an adult woman with long dark-brown waves, subtle smoky eye makeup, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a fully buttoned relaxed white shirt, tailored black trousers, a structured black blazer worn properly on both shoulders, and simple silver jewelry. Stand her beside a parked generic dark coupe at a quiet overcast beachside pull-off with sandy shoreline and gray-blue ocean. Use medium framing, sharp subject, gently blurred coast, soft diffused cloudy daylight, cool muted grade, natural skin, detailed fabric and hair, accurate hands, and restrained detail. No face lock, vehicle badge, plate, logo, readable text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, identity lock, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, open shirt, logo, car badge, license plate, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, AI artifacts
